sentences.text: Shri Manoj Sharma - Senior Advocate with Qazi Fakhrud  Ankit Chopra - Advocates for the Appellant.
Shri B.D. Singh - Deputy Advocate General for the Res None appears for the private respondents.

Appellant impugns order dated 05.02.2024 in W.P.No.7000/2021 and judgment dated 26.02.2024 in Review Petition No.186/2024 whereby the FIR No.37/2021, Police Station, Lalbagh, District Burhanpur under Sections 294, 323, 498A and 506 of I.P.C. and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act against the father, mother and brother of appellant has been quashed and the petition filed by the appellant husband has been dismissed.
Learned senior counsel submits that during the pendency of the writ proceedings by order dated 25.03.2021, the criminal trial was stayed.
Issue fresh notice to respondent No.4.
Notice be made returnable in the week commencing 05th August, 2024.

In the meantime, there shall be stay of the trial in FIR No.37/2021, Police Station, Lalbagh, District Burhanpur (SANJEEV SACHDEVA) (VIVEK JAIN) ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE JUDGE veni Dr. Akshay V.
